amendments.because: The owner decided this on 2 November 2026, after one client's review found a new P0 each round on a prototype with no back end.
amendments.done_when: At prototype sign-off, only a finding with Harm 4 or higher, Gain 5, or a P0 stops the work; every other finding goes to Known issues with no repair round and no question.

done_when: At prototype sign-off, only a finding with Harm 4 or higher, Gain 5, or a P0 stops the work; every other finding goes to Known issues with no repair round and no question. Risks that need a real-data build are build-story work. After round 2, on a repo whose sign-off decision declares only sample data, the owner may accept a remaining P0 with a reason, and it stays a known issue; a repo with real data keeps the hard block.

why: Sign-off judges a sample-data prototype by production rules: its prompt says the full production proof is due now and never says there is no back end, so labelled demo tools can get P0 and production answers can get Not done, and fix-now findings stop the owner for a repair round (GitHub issue 1303).
